# qualtive_enquiry (Data Source)

Looks up a Qualtive enquiry by its current slug. Old slugs of renamed enquiries don't match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "qualtive_enquiry" "contact" {
  container = "acme"
  slug      = "contact"
}

output "contact_enquiry_id" {
  value = data.qualtive_enquiry.contact.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `container` (String) ID of the container the enquiry belongs to.
- `slug` (String) Current slug of the enquiry.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (Number) ID of the workspace to look in. When omitted, the first enquiry with the slug in the container is used.

### Read-Only

- `category_id` (Number) ID of the category the enquiry is filed under, if any.
- `has_draft` (Boolean) Whether someone has unpublished edits to the enquiry in the admin UI.
- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the enquiry.
- `is_user_contact_details_required` (Boolean) Whether feedback posters must leave contact details.
- `name` (Map of String) Name of the enquiry by language code.
- `pages` (String) JSON array of pages, without machine-translated fields.
- `submitted_pages` (String) JSON array of pages shown after submitting, without machine-translated fields.
- `theme` (String) JSON theme object.
